text:
Claire: Heads-up — SolarisEdge issued a time-limited co-marketing credit that was applied to invoices, then billing reversed it after noticing eligibility mismatch. Vendor invoice for reimbursement arrived AFTER reversal. Need guidance for Nov month close: accrue or treat as deferred revenue reduction? Total credit $49,875.

Marco: Quick clarifying q — are these credits billed as customer-facing discounts or is SolarisEdge paying us back separately?

Claire: SolarisEdge reimburses us directly. They applied credits on 2024-11-08, billing reversed on 2024-11-13, vendor invoice dated 2024-11-20. We recognized revenue on 10 invoices. Breakdown below:
```
acct-ALPHA: $20,000 - annual prepaid (9 months remaining)
acct-BETA: $12,375 - usage (recognized)
acct-GAMMA: $8,500 - quarterly prepaid (2 months remaining)
acct-DELTA: $9,000 - annual prepaid (full term, just started)
TOTAL: $49,875
```

Yuki: Policy reminder: usage credits that offset recognized revenue should be reversed immediately. Prepaid credits should be recorded as a deferral and amortized across remaining subscription period. However given vendor invoice exists and payment ETA <60 days we can record a vendor accrual. Because total >$25k, this needs FP&A notification and Finance Lead approval.

Oliver: Draft JEs for review:
```
1) To record accrual and hold deferral balance:
Dr Revenue Deferral (GL 2110) 49,875
  Cr Vendor Accrual / Payable (GL 2210) 49,875

2) Immediately reverse usage-recognized portion (acct-BETA):
Dr Revenue (GL 4050) 12,375
  Cr Revenue Deferral (GL 2110) 12,375
```
Notes: amortize prepaid portion ($37,500) across remaining months by account (per-account schedule). Use weighted allocation for accounts with different remaining terms.

Marco: Confirm vendor PO SE-7782 and SolarisEdge email confirmation — payment ETA 2024-12-11. I'll attach vendor email and invoice to Confluence. fpna-bot: any auto-reminders?

fpna-bot: Reminder — month close lock: 2024-11-30 23:59 PST. For amounts >$25k, route to finance-leads@redwood.com and include vendor invoice + per-invoice mapping + amortization schedule. Submissions must be in by 2024-11-29 EOD for review.

Yuki: Please also include original invoice IDs, billing CSV extract, and a short memo "SolarisEdge promo reversal - Nov24 close". I'll prepare the amort schedule template and post to Confluence.

Claire: I'll upload supporting files now: Confluence link https://confluence.redwood.com/display/FIN/SolarisEdge+promo+reversal. Routing JE to finance-leads@redwood.com and cc accounting@redwood.com. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
